kind: Original distribution acquisition; no training or evaluation labels/partitions assigned
notes: Keep the completed AuDroK intake and its receipts; this separate plan adds other sources.
core contains all field/background files below, including metadata and calibration. Profile sizes are distribution bytes, not independent hours.
metadata selects small source documents and annotation packages only; verification checks transfer mechanics on three real source files.
One active writer per output directory. Interrupted files retain unverified partials; completion requires pinned checksums and stored-byte verification.
Do not extract all archives onto notebook SSD. Preserve originals and prepare bounded native caches in a later versioned step.
Original per-source terms apply. No dataset publication or common license is implied.
RealMAN fixed-channel bulk extraction and remaining AuDroK packages remain subsequent acquisition work; they are not silently included here.

tut2017-development.license: Custom noncommercial research EULA; see publisher doc ZIP.
tut2017-development.role: 4,680 ten-second clips across 15 scenes; 248 original recording IDs, disjoint IDs from evaluation metadata.
tut2017-development.label_support: Publisher scene labels; background training candidate with disclosed label strength.

tut2017-evaluation.license: Custom noncommercial research EULA; see publisher doc ZIP, not a blanket CC/MIT grant.
tut2017-evaluation.role: 1,620 ten-second clips across 15 scenes; 109 original recording IDs recovered from mapping.
tut2017-evaluation.label_support: Scene labels; cannot automatically certify drone-absent continuous benchmark exposure.

urbansound8k.license: CC-BY-NC; inspected original description specifies 3.0, soundata has a conflicting 4.0 constant. Preserve source terms/credits.
urbansound8k.role: 8,732 short foreground-class excerpts from 1,297 Freesound parent IDs; variable native formats.
urbansound8k.label_support: Publisher event class and salience; not exhaustive drone-absence annotation.

idmt-berne-2022.role: Publisher: eight flights, three model families, one Berne campaign; static, linear and random flight, eight-microphone array.
idmt-berne-2022.label_support: Drone position/azimuth metadata; flight presence is not an audible-event annotation.

poland-uav-v1.role: Datasheet: 17 UAV units (repeated models), four locations, five date/site combinations, two recording-device types; hovering measurement grid plus operator speech.
poland-uav-v1.label_support: Measurement-position and drone identities; mixed speech/drone recordings do not establish background-only intervals.

neaptide-v1.role: Four drone models; hover, yaw, ascent/descent and translational manoeuvres. Release is segmented and includes propagation/ground corrections.
neaptide-v1.label_support: Manoeuvre/noise-characterization metadata; original field mixtures and negative coverage not established.

dronenoise-edzell-v3.role: One Edzell field campaign on 2022-08-17; microphone/event names require provenance review.
dronenoise-edzell-v3.label_support: Publisher drone-noise measurements; no verified continuous background or audible-event boundaries established.

dnc.license: Original DepositOnce audio record explicitly links MIT license; source record checked separately from GitHub code.
dnc.role: 4,377 mechanic/melodic/quiet recordings collected through browser audio APIs on Windows/Mac computers.
dnc.label_support: Publisher background-noise classes, not exhaustive outdoor drone-absence labels.
